title: Capacity to Ship Packages Within D Days
description: A conveyor belt has packages that must be shipped from one port to another within days days. The ith package has a weight of weights[i]. Each day, we load packages in order onto the ship. We may not load more weight than the ship's maximum capacity. Return the least weight capacity of the ship that will result in all packages being shipped within days days.
